name: 'CentOS 7 Release'

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build-verify-release:
    name: 'Build, verify, and release JBR for CentOS 7'
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 180

    steps:
      - name: 'Checkout JBR source'
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: 'Get the BootJDK'
        id: bootjdk
        uses: ./.github/actions/get-bootjdk
        with:
          platform: linux-x64

      - name: 'Install host verification tools'
        run: |
          set -euxo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y binutils file

      - name: 'Build JBR without JCEF on glibc 2.17'
        env:
          BUILD_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}.${{ github.run_attempt }}
        run: |
          set -euxo pipefail

          docker pull quay.io/pypa/manylinux2014_x86_64:latest

          docker run --rm \
            -v "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE:/work" \
            -w /work \
            -e BUILD_NUMBER \
            -e BOOT_JDK=/work/bootjdk/jdk \
            -e NO_SPEECHD=1 \
            quay.io/pypa/manylinux2014_x86_64:latest \
            bash -lc '
              set -euxo pipefail

              git config --global --add safe.directory /work

              yum install -y \
                alsa-lib-devel \
                autoconf \
                cups-devel \
                curl \
                dbus-devel \
                vulkan-devel \
                wayland-devel \
                libxkbcommon-devel \
                file \
                fontconfig-devel \
                freetype-devel \
                libX11-devel \
                libXext-devel \
                libXrandr-devel \
                libXrender-devel \
                libXt-devel \
                libXtst-devel \
                libffi-devel \
                make \
                rsync \
                unzip \
                which \
                xz \
                zip

              WAYLAND_PROTOCOLS_VERSION=1.39
              WAYLAND_PROTOCOLS_TARBALL="/tmp/wayland-protocols-${WAYLAND_PROTOCOLS_VERSION}.tar.xz"
              curl --fail --location --retry 5 \
                --output "$WAYLAND_PROTOCOLS_TARBALL" \
                "https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/wayland/wayland-protocols/-/releases/${WAYLAND_PROTOCOLS_VERSION}/downloads/wayland-protocols-${WAYLAND_PROTOCOLS_VERSION}.tar.xz"
              echo "e1dcdcbbf08e2e0a8a02ee5d9a0be3a6aafc39a4b51fa7e0d2f1a16411cb72fa  $WAYLAND_PROTOCOLS_TARBALL" | sha256sum -c -
              rm -rf /opt/wayland-protocols
              mkdir -p /opt/wayland-protocols
              tar -xJf "$WAYLAND_PROTOCOLS_TARBALL" --strip-components=1 -C /opt/wayland-protocols
              test -f /opt/wayland-protocols/staging/xdg-activation/xdg-activation-v1.xml
              test -f /opt/wayland-protocols/staging/xdg-toplevel-icon/xdg-toplevel-icon-v1.xml
              test -f /opt/wayland-protocols/staging/cursor-shape/cursor-shape-v1.xml
              test -f /opt/wayland-protocols/staging/ext-data-control/ext-data-control-v1.xml

              if [[ -d /opt/rh/devtoolset-10/root/usr/bin ]]; then
                export PATH=/opt/rh/devtoolset-10/root/usr/bin:$PATH
              fi

              GLSLANG_VERSION=11.13.0
              GLSLANG_COMMIT=77551c429f86c0e077f26552b7c1c0f12a9f235e
              rm -rf /tmp/glslang /tmp/glslang-build
              git clone --depth 1 --branch "$GLSLANG_VERSION" https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glslang.git /tmp/glslang
              test "$(git -C /tmp/glslang rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GLSLANG_COMMIT"
              PYTHON3_CANDIDATE=
              if [[ -d /opt/python ]]; then
                while IFS= read -r candidate; do
                  if [[ -x "$candidate" ]] && "$candidate" -c "import sys; raise SystemExit(sys.version_info[0] != 3)" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                    PYTHON3_CANDIDATE="$candidate"
                    break
                  fi
                done < <(find /opt/python -path "*/bin/python*" -print | sort)
              fi
              test -n "$PYTHON3_CANDIDATE"
              "$PYTHON3_CANDIDATE" --version

              cmake -S /tmp/glslang -B /tmp/glslang-build \
                -DPYTHON_EXECUTABLE="$PYTHON3_CANDIDATE" \
                -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
                -DENABLE_OPT=OFF \
                -DBUILD_TESTING=OFF \
                -DENABLE_HLSL=OFF \
                -DINSTALL_GTEST=OFF
              cmake --build /tmp/glslang-build --target glslangValidator --parallel 2
              install -m 0755 /tmp/glslang-build/StandAlone/glslangValidator /usr/local/bin/glslangValidator
              glslangValidator --version
              printf "%s\n" "#version 450" "layout(local_size_x = 1) in;" "void main() {}" > /tmp/jbr-vulkan-smoke.comp
              glslangValidator --target-env vulkan1.2 -x -DSTAGE_COMP -o /tmp/jbr-vulkan-smoke.h /tmp/jbr-vulkan-smoke.comp
              test -s /tmp/jbr-vulkan-smoke.h

              echo "Build libc:"
              glibc_line="$(ldd --version 2>&1 | sed -n "1p")"
              echo "$glibc_line"
              grep -F "2.17" <<< "$glibc_line"

              echo "Compiler:"
              gcc --version | sed -n "1p"

              echo "Boot JDK:"
              "$BOOT_JDK/bin/java" -version

              bash jb/project/tools/linux/scripts/mkimages_x64.sh "$BUILD_NUMBER" nomod
            '

      - name: 'Locate JBR bundles'
        id: bundles
        env:
          BUILD_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}.${{ github.run_attempt }}
        run: |
          set -euxo pipefail

          runtime="$(find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -name "jbr-*-linux-x64-b${BUILD_NUMBER}.tar.gz" -print -quit)"
          sdk="$(find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -name "jbrsdk-*-linux-x64-b${BUILD_NUMBER}.tar.gz" -print -quit)"

          test -n "$runtime"
          test -n "$sdk"

          echo "runtime=$runtime" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "sdk=$sdk" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: 'Audit Linux ABI'
        env:
          RUNTIME_TGZ: ${{ steps.bundles.outputs.runtime }}
          SDK_TGZ: ${{ steps.bundles.outputs.sdk }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          rm -rf centos7-audit
          mkdir -p centos7-audit/runtime centos7-audit/sdk
          tar -xzf "$RUNTIME_TGZ" -C centos7-audit/runtime
          tar -xzf "$SDK_TGZ" -C centos7-audit/sdk

          version_gt() {
            local candidate="$1"
            local maximum="$2"
            [[ "$candidate" == "$maximum" ]] && return 1
            [[ "$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$candidate" "$maximum" | sort -V | tail -n 1)" == "$candidate" ]]
          }

          violations=0
          elf_count=0

          while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
            if ! file -b "$f" | grep -q '^ELF '; then
              continue
            fi

            elf_count=$((elf_count + 1))

            while IFS= read -r symbol; do
              [[ -z "$symbol" ]] && continue
              version="${symbol#GLIBC_}"
              if version_gt "$version" "2.17"; then
                echo "::error file=$f::requires $symbol (CentOS 7 maximum is GLIBC_2.17)"
                violations=1
              fi
            done < <(readelf --version-info "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE 'GLIBC_[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)+' | sort -Vu || true)

            while IFS= read -r symbol; do
              [[ -z "$symbol" ]] && continue
              version="${symbol#GLIBCXX_}"
              if version_gt "$version" "3.4.19"; then
                echo "::error file=$f::requires $symbol (CentOS 7 system libstdc++ maximum is GLIBCXX_3.4.19)"
                violations=1
              fi
            done < <(readelf --version-info "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE 'GLIBCXX_[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)+' | sort -Vu || true)

            while IFS= read -r symbol; do
              [[ -z "$symbol" ]] && continue
              version="${symbol#CXXABI_}"
              if version_gt "$version" "1.3.7"; then
                echo "::error file=$f::requires $symbol (CentOS 7 system libstdc++ maximum is CXXABI_1.3.7)"
                violations=1
              fi
            done < <(readelf --version-info "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE 'CXXABI_[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)+' | sort -Vu || true)
          done < <(find centos7-audit -type f -print0)

          echo "Audited ELF files: $elf_count"
          test "$elf_count" -gt 0
          test "$violations" -eq 0

      - name: 'Smoke test on CentOS 7'
        env:
          RUNTIME_TGZ: ${{ steps.bundles.outputs.runtime }}
        run: |
          set -euxo pipefail

          rm -rf centos7-smoke
          mkdir -p centos7-smoke
          tar -xzf "$RUNTIME_TGZ" -C centos7-smoke
          runtime_dir="$(find "$PWD/centos7-smoke" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -name 'jbr-*' -print -quit)"
          test -n "$runtime_dir"

          docker pull quay.io/centos/centos:7

          docker run --rm quay.io/centos/centos:7 \
            bash -lc 'glibc_line="$(ldd --version 2>&1 | sed -n "1p")"; echo "$glibc_line"; grep -F "2.17" <<< "$glibc_line"'

          docker run --rm \
            -v "$runtime_dir:/opt/jbr:ro" \
            quay.io/centos/centos:7 \
            /opt/jbr/bin/java -version

          docker run --rm \
            -v "$runtime_dir:/opt/jbr:ro" \
            quay.io/centos/centos:7 \
            /opt/jbr/bin/java -Xshare:on -XX:+AllowEnhancedClassRedefinition -version

      - name: 'Prepare release metadata'
        id: release
        env:
          BUILD_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}.${{ github.run_attempt }}
          RUNTIME_TGZ: ${{ steps.bundles.outputs.runtime }}
          SDK_TGZ: ${{ steps.bundles.outputs.sdk }}
        run: |
          set -euxo pipefail

          runtime_name="$(basename "$RUNTIME_TGZ")"
          version="${runtime_name#jbr-}"
          version="${version%-linux-x64-b${BUILD_NUMBER}.tar.gz}"
          source_sha="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          tag="centos7-jbr-${version}-b${BUILD_NUMBER}"

          sha256sum "$RUNTIME_TGZ" "$SDK_TGZ" > SHA256SUMS

          cat > release-notes.md <<EOF
          Custom JetBrains Runtime build for CentOS 7 / glibc 2.17 without JCEF.

          Source repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          Source ref: main
          Source SHA: ${source_sha}
          JBR version: ${version}
          Custom build number: ${BUILD_NUMBER}

          Validation performed by this workflow:
          - built in manylinux2014 (CentOS 7 / glibc 2.17 baseline) with GCC 10
          - JCEF excluded via nomod bundle type
          - GLIBC <= 2.17
          - GLIBCXX <= 3.4.19
          - CXXABI <= 1.3.7
          - java -version in a CentOS 7 container
          - CDS + JetBrains enhanced class redefinition startup smoke test

          This is an unofficial custom build and is not supported by JetBrains.
          EOF

          echo "tag=$tag" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "title=JBR ${version} for CentOS 7 (b${BUILD_NUMBER})" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "source_sha=$source_sha" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: 'Create GitHub Release'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RUNTIME_TGZ: ${{ steps.bundles.outputs.runtime }}
          SDK_TGZ: ${{ steps.bundles.outputs.sdk }}
          TAG: ${{ steps.release.outputs.tag }}
          TITLE: ${{ steps.release.outputs.title }}
          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ steps.release.outputs.source_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euxo pipefail

          gh release create "$TAG" \
            "$RUNTIME_TGZ" \
            "$SDK_TGZ" \
            SHA256SUMS \
            --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --target "$SOURCE_SHA" \
            --title "$TITLE" \
            --notes-file release-notes.md \
            --prerelease

      - name: 'Summary'
        env:
          TAG: ${{ steps.release.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          {
            echo '### CentOS 7 JBR release created'
            echo
            echo "- Tag: \`$TAG\`"
            echo "- Source: \`${{ github.repository }}@main\`"
            echo "- Source SHA: \`${{ steps.release.outputs.source_sha }}\`"
            echo '- Release workflow rebuilt and revalidated the binaries independently.'
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
